d:
Bihar ke mujaphpharpur se ek aisi prernadayi tasvir samne aaee hai jo aapko insani himmat, hausle aur adig jajbe ki had sochne par majbur kar denge. kahte hain ki jindgi men mushkilen kitni bhi bari kyon na hon, agar hausle majbut hon to raste khud ban jate hain. is divyang danpti ki kahani isi kahavat ko sach sabit karti hai.
